note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 after commit cd9c79b63c changed internal/plugins/geodns/server.go::answerQuestions. RFC 4035 Section 2.2 reads 'For each authoritative RRset in a signed zone, there MUST be at least one RRSIG record that meets the following requirements:'. The change makes answerQuestions report whether an answer read the client-selected host set (the tailored result feeding the RFC 7871 ECS echo in answerQuery); its qtype switch still builds only A, AAAA, SRV and ANY from the host set, SOA and NS, with the default arm answering SOA in Authority, and internal/plugins/as112/zones.go::answerQuestions still builds only SOA, NS, the hostname TXT or a negative answer. No producer in internal/plugins/geodns, internal/plugins/as112 or internal/core/dnsserver creates an RRSIG, DNSKEY or NSEC record, so no zone Ze serves is signed and no RRSIG exists for any authoritative RRset. The row stays a counted {gap}; the code does not meet it.
